newsitem.title: SPAIN: BCH, Vicasa agree to sell Vilesa - Spain's CNMV. [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BCH, Vicasa agree to sell Vilesa - Spain's CNMV. [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT]

text.p: Spain's Banco Central Hispano and Vicasa have reached an agreement to sell their respective 36 percent and 15 percent stakes in Vidriera Leonesa SA (Vilesa) to Vista Desarrollo and Royal Bank Investments Ltd, national stock market commission CNMV said on Friday.
The two companies buying the stakes will then launch a buyout of Vilesa (corrects from Vicasa) at 2,520 pesetas per share, the CNMV said.
Vilesa is traded on Madrid's open outcry exchange. CNMV said it was suspending trade in the shares following the announcement of the deal.
No-one at BCH was immediately available to comment.
